title: Alert Dialog
description: A confirmation dialog for destructive actions, with initial focus on the safer choice.
usage: Connect the destructive button to your own action. Backdrop clicks do not dismiss this dialog. Escape follows the native cancel → close path; applications can listen for cancel and treat Escape as cancellation, or prevent its default if needed.
a11y: Uses native <dialog> with role="alertdialog". Initial focus uses data-autofocus/autofocus, then the first non-primary button, then the dialog itself to avoid placing focus on a destructive action. Tab cycles inside. Native Escape emits cancel and closes; backdrop clicks do not close. Close restores the opener; IDs are generated without replacing existing IDs.
